name: tools.audiolab/audiolab
description: Loudness, true-peak and voice-quality analysis of URLs and local files via the hosted AudioLab API.

environmentVariables.name: AUDIOLAB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from https://audiolab.tools/account. Free tier: 1,000 calls and 2 GB per month, no card.

environmentVariables.name: AUDIOLAB_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Defaults to https://audiolab.tools/v1. The value must include the /v1 path segment.
